answers.text: Have it return the same three-line shape every time — date, item/quantity, then change. Line one is the date alone, line two is item and quantity together, line three is the change or 'none'.
Get it to list every claim on its own line with date, amount, category and submitter, then a total.
The dates in this don't quite line up.
62 up from 54 does come close to 15%, that checks out.
I'd sign off Output 2 — it shows its working.
I'd probably go with whichever one reads better for the customer. Reply 1 is short and to the point, so that's the one I'd send — Reply 2 has a lot of extra detail that might not be needed.
